Generated by scripts/make_cedar.py from the committed fhp.json bytes, source schema SHA-256: 2409739d4a223164ca368f93afa78c8f1e3809fb04ec46cc9a793cc5aaaba427; do not hand edit. propertyDescriptions.checksum: sha2-512/256 checksum value for hashing. Computed by `bioheaders combine` over the exact file bytes; never write or edit a checksum by hand.
propertyDescriptions.completeness: BUSCO completeness of the protein set, as counts.
propertyDescriptions.dateCreated: Date the protein set was created.
propertyDescriptions.derivedFrom: Parent files this file was derived from, identified by their FHR-family checksum. Header types opt in by listing this slot; FHR schemaVersion 1 does not include it.
propertyDescriptions.geneticCode: NCBI translation table ID used to translate the sequences (1-6, 9-16 or 21-33); omitted when unknown or when the file mixes tables. The contract allows only the ranges 1-6, 9-16 and 21-33; the numeric input cannot block the gaps, so validate before combining.
propertyDescriptions.isoformPolicy: Which protein isoforms of each gene the set contains.
propertyDescriptions.predictionProtocol: Prediction or annotation protocol or workflow reference URI.
propertyDescriptions.predictionSoftware: Software that produced the gene models or translations.
propertyDescriptions.relatedLink: Related URLs to the protein set.
propertyDescriptions.reuseConditions: Reuse conditions or license for the protein set.
propertyDescriptions.header_schema: URL of the FHP JSON Schema this record follows (raw-main, a release's raw tag URL or its w3id URL; docs/SCHEMA-VERSIONS.md); it identifies the header type (FR-011). This template fixes the FHP contract URL to the released v0.5.0 version (https://w3id.org/fair-bioheaders/fhp/v0.5.0); docs/SCHEMA-VERSIONS.md allows other URLs for existing records.
propertyDescriptions.schemaVersion: Version of the FHP schema contract ("MAJOR.MINOR"); 1.1 (extension fields) from v0.5.
propertyDescriptions.scholarlyArticle: Scholarly article where the protein set was published. A registered DOI without the resolver prefix (for example 10.5281/zenodo.6762550).
propertyDescriptions.sequenceStats: Counts describing the protein set, as asserted by the producer.
propertyDescriptions.source: Sources of the sequences that are not FAIR-bioHeaders files, as asserted by the producer; never verified by checksum.
propertyDescriptions.sourceType: Where the sequences came from: predicted (a gene-prediction or annotation run), database (a published database release, set or annotation run) or mixed (more than one origin). Not a review status.
propertyDescriptions.taxon: Species name and URL of the species information at identifiers.org.
